[LDIA.9.2] **`default`** sets each capability as the table states:

| Setting | Capabilities |
|---|---|
| `true` | `call`, `publish`, `cache`, `cache_delete`, `nocooldown`, `regex`, `series`, `logical`, `linear_scan`, `float` |
| `false` | `realtime`, `constspace`, `dynamic_ttl`, `sampled_slots`, `persist_on_series`, `storage_hydrate_facts`, `storage_hydrate_samples` |

The deferred capabilities are `false` here as everywhere in this edition
([LCAP.2.1.5], [LCAP.2.10]).
